summary: A website that converts person images into different emotions and then transforms them into various cartoon styles including Ghibli-style
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Hero background with artistic paint strokes and transformation motifs in warm sunset tones (hero-background.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Sample Ghibli-style transformation example showing before and after (ghibli-example.dim_800x600.png)
- Emotion icon set: happy face illustration (emotion-happy.dim_64x64.png)
- Emotion icon set: sad face illustration (emotion-sad.dim_64x64.png)
- Emotion icon set: surprised face illustration (emotion-surprised.dim_64x64.png)
- Emotion icon set: angry face illustration (emotion-angry.dim_64x64.png)
- Emotion icon set: neutral face illustration (emotion-neutral.dim_64x64.png)
- Upload area placeholder illustration with camera and image icons (upload-placeholder.dim_400x300.png)

existing_features.title: Create an image upload interface that accepts person photos in common formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP) with drag-and-drop support and file size validation
Implement emotion transformation selector allowing users to choose target emotions: happy, sad, surprised, angry, neutral
Implement cartoon style selector with options including: Ghibli-style, classic cartoon, anime, comic book, and watercolor styles
Build processing workflow that applies emotion transformation to the uploaded image based on user selection
Build processing workflow that applies cartoon style transformation to the emotion-adjusted image based on user selection
Display transformed images with side-by-side comparison view showing original, emotion-adjusted, and final cartoon-styled versions
Implement download functionality allowing users to save the final transformed image to their device
Add loading states and progress indicators during image upload and transformation processing

Design a visually cohesive interface with a creative artistic theme that emphasizes transformation and creativity, using warm, inviting colors and playful typography that reflects the fun, artistic nature of image manipulation

new_feature_requests.summary: Convert person images into different emotions
Transform images into various cartoon styles including Ghibli-style
Create backend endpoint to store uploaded person images and track transformation requests with user sessions
